Name: Unicorn Horse
Author: jackharvest
Description:
My 9 year old made this in Paint 3D. She edited every pixel 1 by 1 and created a unicorn out of your horse. She's ecstatic, and wants everyone to see it. This content goes in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\UnicornHorse and contains the following:

[list]
[*]Animals
[*]- horse.png
[*]content.json
[*]manifest.json
[/list]
Its our first family upload and I barely know enough to have it show up in the game. Any feedback is great! She's off to making more things!

Downloads.Description:
Extract these into a folder called unicornhorse, and slap it into your mods folder. Like so:
c:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\unicornhorse\

Manifest.Name: Unicorn Horse
Manifest.Description: Changes your horse into a unicorn!
